title: Concept: Xdebug variable dump disclosed in a response
description: Xdebug renders var_dump() as HTML carrying the file path, the line number and the full value tree. A dump left in production discloses the exact code location and the data that reached it, which is both a source map and a data leak in one response.
applicability: Responses generated by a PHP application with Xdebug enabled in a deployed environment.
risk: The caller learns file paths, line numbers and the contents of variables that may hold credentials, tokens or personal data.
